mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, user_id, session_id, run_id, seq, event_type, payload_json, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT nextval('fin_ex_chat_event_seq') AS seq FROM generate_series(1, #{count}) AS generated(event_order) ORDER BY generated.event_order

SELECT r.tenant_id, r.user_id, r.session_id, r.id AS run_id FROM fin_ex_chat_run_t r JOIN fin_ex_chat_session_t s ON s.id = r.session_id AND s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.id = #{runId} AND r.session_id = #{sessionId}

SELECT r.tenant_id, r.user_id, r.session_id, r.id AS run_id FROM fin_ex_chat_run_t r JOIN fin_ex_chat_session_t s ON s.id = r.session_id AND s.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND s.user_id = r.user_id JOIN fin_ex_chat_run_execution_t e ON e.run_id = r.id AND e.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND e.user_id = r.user_id AND e.session_id = r.session_id WHERE r.id = #{runId} AND r.session_id = #{sessionId} AND r.status = 'RUNNING' AND e.owner_instance_id = #{ownerInstanceId} AND e.fencing_token = #{fencingToken} AND e.execution_status = 'RUNNING' FOR SHARE OF r NOWAIT FOR SHARE OF e

INSERT INTO fin_ex_chat_event_t( id, tenant_id, user_id, session_id, run_id, seq, event_type, payload_json, created_at ) VALUES
(#{row.id}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.userId}, #{row.sessionId}, #{row.runId}, #{row.seq}, #{row.eventType}, #{row.payloadJson}, #{row.createdAt, javaType=java.time.Instant, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
